build_colour_map: build a randomized symbol to colour mapping using get_shuffled_symbol_colour_map with a seed and list of symbols
create_cropper: create a scrolling cropper that tracks the player sprite using get_cropper with default 5x5 viewport
build_distractor_engine: build a distractor phase game engine with configurable apples and max frames using distractor_phase
replace_grid_symbols: replace symbols in a text grid using a mapping dictionary with replace_grid_symbols
sample_grid_characters: sample and keep only n instances of a character in a grid using keep_n_characters_in_grid
